The '''Kosovo Agency of Statistics''' ({{langx|sq|Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës}}'', ASK;'' {{langx|sr-Latn|Agencija za statistiku Kosova}}) is the national statistics bureau of [[Kosovo]].<ref>{{cite web |publisher=Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës (ASK) |title=Overview |url=https://ask.rks-gov.net/en/kosovo-agency-of-statistics/footer/overview |accessdate=22 September 2020 |archive-date=2 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230802002805/https://ask.rks-gov.net/en/kosovo-agency-of-statistics/footer/overview |url-status=dead }}</ref>

It was officially established in 1948,<ref>{{Cite news|last=Ramadani|first=Drenushë|date=22 June 2022|title=Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës rikthehet në Kryeministri|language=sq|work=[[Kallxo]]|url=https://kallxo.com/lajm/agjencia-e-statistikave-te-kosoves-rikthehet-ne-kryeministri/|access-date=25 June 2025}}</ref> but restarted working as an independent agency in 1999.<ref>{{cite web|title=KAS, history|url=http://ask.rks-gov.net/per-ask-ne|publisher=KAS|access-date=2015-01-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150105234647/http://ask.rks-gov.net/per-ask-ne|archive-date=2015-01-05|url-status=dead}}</ref> After [[2008 Kosovo declaration of independence|Kosovo's declaration of independence]] in 2008, the ''ACK'' organized Kosovo's first population census in 2011. It is supported by international organizations and statistic agencies, like the [[OSCE]], [[United Nations]], etc. As of 2011, the bureau works within the Kosovo Prime Ministry framework.<ref>{{cite web|title=KAS history|url=http://ask.rks-gov.net/eng/|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150120010016/http://ask.rks-gov.net/eng/|archivedate=2015-01-20}}</ref>

The last census organized by Kosovo Agency of Statistics took place during April and May of 2024.<ref name=":1">{{cite web |title=Population and housing census in Kosovo preliminary results - July 2024 |url=https://askapi.rks-gov.net/Custom/1d268e37-5934-4bd5-bbd1-34a9965cff92.pdf |access-date=21 July 2024}}</ref>
